commitObject.message:
spirv-opt: Reorder access chain and multi-dim array passes (#6545)

The combine-access-chain pass leaves dead code that breaks the
legalization pass. Additionally, the legalize-multi-dim-arrays pass
creates arithmetic expressions that could be folded.

This commit moves these passes earlier in the pipeline to ensure the
code they create can be cleaned up. It is safe to move them earlier
because they are flexible and do not depend on the later passes.

commitObject.message:
Fix Int64ImageEXT capability prerequisite to Int64 (#611)

The Int64ImageEXT capability listed Shader as its prerequisite, but per SPV_EXT_shader_image_int64 spec (https://github.khronos.org/SPIRV-Registry/extensions/EXT/SPV_EXT_shader_image_int64.html) it implicitly declares Int64
